question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 5.
solution:
The correct answer is '**monthly**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The passage discusses changes and trends in tea prices over time.
 
• The phrase "In the subsequent four months" indicates that the passage is referring to a time period where monthly tracking of prices would be relevant.
 
• "**Monthly**" fits well as it aligns with the context of discussing changes over a period of several months.
 
• Other options such as "**half yearly**", "**weekly**", and "**yearly**" do not appropriately fit the context of a four-month period analysis.

Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 1**'.
